ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee to the rider; do not penalise the driver (no fraud indicator — arrival was genuine), but remind the driver that the free-wait requirement is not met unless a call is actually answered.
ruling.reasoning: No-show charge of $5.00 (trip T-2035, driver cancelled at 14:13:40 for "rider_no_show"). Driver arrived 14:07:40 (app event driver_arrived) and GPS places him ~0.01 km from Buona Vista MRT (1.30633, 103.78995 vs pickup 1.3063, 103.7903) — well within 200 m. Counting the 5-minute free wait from the later of scheduled pickup time and arrival (14:07:40), the wait expired 14:12:40; cancellation at 14:13:40 is past it, so NS-1(i) and (ii) hold. But NS-1(iii) requires, before cancelling, at least 1 in-app message AND at least 1 in-app call. The record shows one chat message (14:08:10) and one call attempt at 14:09:10 that was NOT answered (answered:false, duration 0). An unanswered call is not the required in-app call contact, so condition (iii) fails. Under NS-2 any failed NS-1 condition voids the fee: refund_full of $5.00. Because the driver was genuinely at the pickup point and arrival is corroborated by GPS and app event, there is no fraudulent-arrival basis for flag_account. Evidence is otherwise complete (GPS coverage, timestamped messages, call records, who cancelled), so the system may decide rather than escalate; amount $5.00 is below $10 and no-show/cancellation is a system-final category (TH-1, TH-2).

element_findings.element: NS-1(i) driver arrived at pickup (I'm Here / auto-arrival with GPS within 200 m)
element_findings.reason: Arrival event plus GPS ~0.01 km from the pickup point satisfies the 200 m rule.

element_findings.element: NS-1(ii) 5-minute free wait elapsed before cancellation
element_findings.reason: Wait runs from the later of scheduled time and arrival (14:07:40) and expired 14:12:40; cancellation at 14:13:40 is past it.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iii) before cancelling, driver sent ≥1 in-app message AND made ≥1 in-app call
element_findings.reason: One in-app message exists, but the only call attempt was unanswered (duration 0 s, no recording/transcript) — no contact was actually made, so the cumulative condition fails.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iv) driver stayed at the pickup point throughout
basis: gps 14:08:00–14:13:40 all at North Buona Vista Rd, speed ~0–2 km/h
element_findings.reason: Telemetry shows the vehicle stationary at the pickup point from arrival until cancellation; the 14:09–14:12 sampling gap is thinning of a continuous trace, not evidence of departure.

rejected_claims.reason: The 5-minute wait did elapse (14:07:40–14:13:40), but the driver states he waited rather than that he contacted the rider; the record shows his only call went unanswered, so the NS-1(iii) contact requirement is not established and his no-show claim fails.
